plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: 中文版:指挥/执行/评审三层多代理工作流 —— /scaffold 文档脚手架 + /whats-next 进度导航 + /sop-generate 业务操作手册生成，新会话自动铺设新项目脚手架（auto-scaffold）

plugins.name: workflow-en
plugins.description: English version: Conductor/Executor/Reviewer multi-agent workflow — /scaffold doc scaffolding + /whats-next progress navigation + /sop-generate business SOP generation, auto-scaffold new projects on new sessions (auto-scaffold)

plugins.name: speak-human
plugins.description: 中文版:让 Claude 说人话、会提问——提问前自检清单 + 表达纪律,规则源自 548 次真实抉择记录挖掘;touch ~/.claude/.speak-human-always 常驻

plugins.name: speak-human-en
plugins.description: English version: make Claude speak human and ask well — pre-question self-check + expression discipline, mined from 548 real decision records; touch ~/.claude/.speak-human-always for always-on

plugins.name: send-to
plugins.description: 中文版:/send-to <会话名> 把消息转达给本机另一个 Claude Code 会话——会话名模糊匹配、多命中/零命中亮列表、消息自包含、如实汇报挂起状态;跨 profile 窗口互不可见但 uds: 地址可直发(标准路径),SessionStart 注册 hook 把 socket 清单翻译成身份注册表认人,四级找目标阶梯,文件交接降级为最后兜底(需 Claude Code v2.1.224+,macOS/Linux)

plugins.name: send-to-en
plugins.description: English version: /send-to <session-name> relays a message to another Claude Code session on this machine — fuzzy name matching, list-on-ambiguity, self-contained messages, honest held-delivery reporting; cross-profile windows are mutually invisible but reachable via a direct uds: address (the standard path), a SessionStart registration hook translates the socket list into an identity registry for recognition, a four-tier target-finding ladder, file handoff as the final fallback (needs Claude Code v2.1.224+, macOS/Linux)

plugins.name: ui-sweep
plugins.description: 中文版:SOP 截图前/改完一批 UI 后,把全站可交互元素系统性点一遍——agent-browser 驱动 + 通用化遍历引擎(config 外置、默认拦截名单只增不减、六分类记账);破坏性按钮只记不点、confirm/prompt 一律驳回、--allowed-domains 圈死目标域

plugins.name: ui-sweep-en
plugins.description: English version: before SOP screenshots or after a batch of UI changes, systematically click every interactive element on the site — driven by agent-browser plus a generalized traversal engine (externalized config, append-only default denylist, six-category ledger); destructive buttons are logged not clicked, confirm/prompt always dismissed, --allowed-domains locks the target domain
